title: QBIND Public DevNet Package Integrity Manifest
description: Canonical, publish-safe manifest describing the documented QBIND public DevNet release-package DOCUMENTATION artifact tree under docs/release/public-devnet. It lets an operator or reviewer confirm that the listed package files are present and unchanged (SHA-256 + byte size) before following OPERATOR_VERIFICATION_MAP.md. Docs/artifact only: it embeds NO binary blob, NO secret, NO private path/hostname/endpoint, NO raw log, NO raw /metrics dump, and NO generated private identity. It is NOT binary provenance (see binary/RELEASE_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.schema.json for that) and it moves NO readiness item: M4 stays Yellow, M6 stays Yellow/Partial, S5/S7 stay Yellow, public DevNet stays NOT launch-ready, and C4/C5 stay OPEN.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version (semver of this schema contract).

generated_for_run.description: The QBIND run number this manifest was generated for. Fixed to 404.

scope.description: Stable scope tag for this manifest. Documentation package only.

safety_labels.description: Standing safety labels every artifact this manifest describes carries. All required labels must be present.

package_root.description: Repository-relative root of the documented public DevNet package. All file relative_path values are resolved against this root. Never an absolute path.

generated_at_utc.description: OPTIONAL UTC timestamp (ISO-8601, Zulu) when this manifest was generated. May be included only if the reproducibility rules in PACKAGE_INTEGRITY.md are followed honestly; hashes and byte sizes are the authoritative integrity signal and do not depend on this field.

files.description: The documented public DevNet package file entries covered by this manifest.

relative_path.description: Path of the file RELATIVE to package_root (docs/release/public-devnet). Forward-slash separated, never absolute, never containing '..', never a Windows drive path.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the on-disk file at package_root/relative_path.

byte_size.description: Exact byte size of the on-disk file.

artifact_group.description: The artifact group (matches ARTIFACT_INDEX.md) the file belongs to.

readiness_item.description: The readiness matrix item(s) the file's group covers, verbatim label (e.g. 'M4', 'M6', 'S5', 'S7', 'M1/M19/M20', 'launch-gate').

status.description: The current recorded status of the file's group. Must not overclaim: Yellow items stay Yellow.

verification_reference.description: Repository-relative pointer to the VERIFY.md / doc / harness used to verify the file's group. Never an absolute path.

non_claims.description: Explicit non-claim booleans. Every field must be exactly as fixed below (this manifest makes none of these claims).

artifact_safety_label.description: Standing human-readable safety label for every artifact this manifest describes.
artifact_safety_label.const: experimental · resettable · no value · no uptime SLA · NOT public-DevNet launch-ready · no MainNet readiness claim · no C4/C5 closure claim
